# SYNTHETIC. The NEGATIVE CONTROL of the whole filename reader: every stem here
# carries at least one token the profile does not know, and every stem must still
# yield a named statement for every token it DOES know, plus an `unknown_token`
# statement for the rest. One unknown token never discards a filename.
#
# an English word in the middle of an otherwise readable stem (real: the `for`
# in a MERGE product's name)
SyOx_5wpc_pellet_HERFD_for_TRANSMISSION
# a stem that is one unknown word and nothing else (real: `alignment`)
alignment
# an invented word no profile will ever know, between two it does
07_01_ZZ1_acid_zzzUnknownToken_filter10_100mV
# two unknowns in one stem, and the recognised tokens on both sides of them
55_05_ZZ3_base_widgetMode_after1500Cycling_flubber_filter20_400mV
# a doubled separator, which changes the token indices a scientist counts by eye
08_01_ZZ1__acid_beforeCycling_filter10_100mV
# a stem with NO recognisable token at all
totally_opaque_thing
